requiredFindings.title: Do not turn libproc listing failures into Complete(empty)
requiredFindings.description: Both bounded listings test only for a negative native return. On this host, the libproc wrappers return zero on a failed underlying proc_info call: proc_listpids converts -1 to 0; proc_listchildpids converts -1 to 0 and otherwise divides bytes by sizeof(pid_t). Consequently a failure with errno set reaches listing(buf, 0, capacity) and becomes Ok(Listing::Complete(vec![])). The snapshot cannot distinguish ListingFailed from a complete empty child set, and group sampling/confirmation receives false successful enumeration evidence. M3-D item 18 and LD-D3B-3 require listing failure to remain distinguishable. The six positive-path controls and eight mutations do not cover zero-with-error returns.
requiredFindings.evidence: Read-only inspection of this host's dyld shared cache, image /usr/lib/system/libsystem_kernel.dylib, exports _proc_listpids at unslid 0x180852ef0 and _proc_listchildpids at 0x18085cc64: the former ends its underlying-call return handling with cmn w0,#1; csel w0,wzr,w0,eq (words 0x3100041f, 0x1a8003e0). The latter uses asr w8,w0,#2; cmn w0,#1; csel w0,wzr,w8,eq (0x13027c08, 0x3100041f, 0x1a8803e0). Thus -1 is explicitly returned to these Rust callers as zero, not negative. No native API probe or build was run.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Handle the wrappers' zero-on-error convention with per-call errno discipline, distinguishing a legitimate empty list from a failure without consulting stale errno. Preserve the call name and errno in LaunchError::Io. Add deterministic controls for zero-with-error on each listing, successful empty children, and stale incoming errno; mutations that read a listing error as Complete(empty) must fail. Keep the single fixed capacity-plus-one buffer and the count-versus-bytes distinction.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Archive the rebase record under its actual attempt
nonBlockingObservations.description: REQUEST/SCOPE refer to the packaged lane's rebased.json, but that file is absent from both the package and its 30-member manifest. The actual record is /tmp/opensip-implementation/d3b0-checks-r1-attempt2/rebased.json: 274dccc5eced53828f444fa44e62cdeffabc2d0c to 2ead5cf1796bb85f363c34fa8ff8fba715462369. Git independently confirms that record's changed-file set and that both this move and the complete d704ed4-to-lane-base change set are disjoint from the three candidate paths. The final lane is correctly pinned at 2ead5cf, so this is a provenance correction, not a base mismatch.
nonBlockingObservations.requestedChange: Archive and hash the attempt-2 rebase record and correct the references to its attempt; do not imply the final already-aligned attempt itself performed that move.
